title: Korean Bros by TRUFFL - snack grocery cart
steal: Saturated cyan backdrop behind hot-pink/yellow bubble-lettered packs; starburst badges and Korean typographic accents stacked edge to edge, a loud K-snack shelf wall.

title: Outfry Korean fried chicken - sticker system on black
steal: Die-cut mascot sticker set (blue/red/white outlines) scattered on a flat field plus small Hangul seal stamps; copy for the bear sticker sheet and menu-item badges.

title: Outfry - repeating giant type pattern with mascot
steal: Tight tilted, repeated chunky wordmark filling the whole red field with Hangul tag and mascot overlapping it; a ready-made giant-type background behind content.

title: Sonamu Killer Kimchi pouch
steal: One flat saturated red-orange block with oversized all-caps type, nothing else; proof a single colour plus giant type is enough on a section.

title: Sun Noodle Ramen box on red-orange
steal: Orange-red backdrop with pale yellow/pink pack and a sun-ray badge; warm orange + cream-yellow pairing close to the 60/30 palette.

title: Hongdae Korean Ramyeon restaurant branding
steal: Cobalt-blue bowls with chunky outlined lettering on yellow table, pink/blue tile grid behind; a checkerboard/tile strip next to cobalt-outlined type.

title: KIMCHI TO GO x Seollal 2026 print and packaging
steal: Flat geometric food icons in a red/green/yellow grid pattern on bags and stickers; a repeatable icon-tile pattern for section backgrounds.

title: GOGOBAB Korean street food menu design
steal: Orange and white menu boards with huge stacked KIM BAB / DOSHIRAK headings and round food photos in circles; menu hierarchy straight from a Korean street-food counter.

title: ICoffee brand - cobalt, yellow, orange flat colour blocking
steal: Cobalt blue field with pale yellow and orange flat illustration stripes; the exact blue/yellow/orange retro-pop colour pairing on a flat ground.

title: Kokkopi branding identity
steal: Packs, boxes and stickers sharing one doodle-character pattern; shows how a sticker pattern can carry a whole brand surface.

title: POCHA street food branding - food truck and boxes
steal: Red/orange/yellow/blue wave and circle patterns wrapped across a food truck and takeaway boxes; bold wavy pattern bands as a decorative language.

title: POCHA identity, branding and packaging board
steal: Brand board of colour-blocked tiles (red, yellow, blue) with sticker logo, pattern swatches and photo cut-outs; a modular tile layout for the menu home.

title: Orange-yellow playful Korean food festival banner
steal: Orange backdrop, hand-drawn bowl illustration and giant outlined FOOD FESTIVAL lettering; the closest mood match to the MOBA orange + pale yellow.

title: Eat Up noodle restaurant packaging
steal: Fat bubbly orange/yellow wordmark on cups and boxes over a solid orange field; bubbly-type plus flat orange colour field like Bagel Fat One.

title: Party graphics sticker sheet
steal: Dense overlapping die-cut sticker collage with white borders; use as a scattered sticker layer behind menu categories.

title: Playful sticker-based brand identity
steal: Starburst, flower and speech-bubble badges in primary colours with thick outlines; copy the badge shapes for NEW / SPICY / BEST SELLER tags.

title: Cake shop landing page with wavy dividers
steal: Soft wavy section edge between hero and content in warm peach/orange; simple sine-wave divider to separate menu sections.

title: Pet care e-commerce landing with wavy section breaks
steal: Red, white and blue bands separated by deep wave edges and curved cut-outs; stacked wavy colour bands for orange, yellow and blue sections.

title: Playful cookie brand website
steal: Giant ONE BITE ... JOY hero type in rounded font over warm orange with squiggle and sticker accents; hero type overlapping the product.

title: Retro Devnagri brand graphic with checker frame
steal: Black-and-white checkerboard border, flowers and bold script around a cut-out portrait; checker strip as a frame or divider.

title: Gulp! pop-art sparkling water merch
steal: Pop-art lips, droplets and bubble lettering in teal/orange/blue on flat green ground; sticker-like shapes with offset shadows.

title: Hamsachin Korean-style font specimen
steal: Mustard-yellow ground with a huge ghosted glyph cropped behind the title; ghost-letter treatment for giant cropped type behind content (use real Hangul, not faux).

title: Inner City poster lettering
steal: Fat stacked INNER CITY letters stuffed with doodle characters on a flat pink ground; characters living inside giant type.

title: OrangeYouGlad sticker takeover
steal: Full-screen pile of cartoon sticker characters over a pale green field with a marquee strip; sticker pile as a hero or loading screen.
